description: Extracts the key terms of construction specifications, offers and contracts

CompletionDate.description: Date by which the construction work has to be completed. Leave empty if the document names no completion date.

TermStart.description: First day of the construction period or contract term. Leave empty if not stated.

TermEnd.description: Last day of the construction period or contract term. Leave empty if not stated.

FixedPriceEur.description: Fixed price of the work in euros, net, as a plain number. Leave empty if the document names no fixed price.

BudgetEur.description: Budget of the client in euros, as a plain number. Leave empty if the document names no budget.

AssumedPermitDate.description: Date by which the document assumes that the building permit is issued. Leave empty if there is no such assumption.

AcceptanceDeadline.description: Latest date for the acceptance of the finished work. Leave empty if not stated.

PenaltyPercentPerWorkingDay.description: Contractual penalty for delay, in percent of the contract value per working day. Leave empty if there is no penalty clause.

PenaltyCapPercent.description: Maximum of the contractual penalty in percent of the contract value. Leave empty if there is no cap.

WithdrawalDelayWeeks.description: Number of weeks of delay after which the client may withdraw from the contract. Leave empty if there is no such clause.

ChangeRateEurPerHour.description: Hourly rate in euros that is charged for changes outside the specification. Leave empty if there is no such rate.

OverrunApprovalThresholdPercent.description: Percentage by which the budget may be exceeded before the client has to approve in writing. Leave empty if there is no such clause.
